title: manuscript-guard vault registry
description: The files of the vault, the folder outside the project where the data are held and which the operating system keeps from the agent. Written by `manuscript-guard vault init` at design/vault.yaml and committed. Each file is named by its path inside the folder and its digests, never by its contents or by where the folder is on a machine (that is .manuscript-guard/vault.local.yaml, which git ignores). No row count: a count is a result, and leaves the vault only through a person's release.

label.description: The file's path inside the vault's folder, with forward slashes.

sha256.description: As the emitter digests an input it read: line endings left out of a text format (emit.input_digest).

raw_sha256.description: The digest of the file's bytes as they are (emit.sha256_of).

registered_by.description: Who registered the file, as given to --as.
